[EVENT] User focuses on cleaning the kitchen on Wednesdays.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for cleaning the oven, including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Turn off the oven and let it cool completely.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Take out the racks and shelves and wash them in soapy water.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. If the oven has a self-cleaning cycle, check the manual and follow instructions.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. For manual cleaning, mix a paste of baking soda and water, apply it, and let it sit overnight.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Use a long-handled brush or scrubber to remove the paste and grime.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Wipe clean with a damp cloth and dry the oven surfaces.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for oven cleaning include using a silicone oven liner and avoiding abrasive cleaners.  
[FACT] User has been trying to incorporate a "one-touch rule" into their daily routine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips to maintain the "one-touch rule," including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Designate a home for each item.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Create a routine.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Make it a habit loop.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Start small.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Make it a family effort.
